entries.name: 石墨烯单层
entries.phase: single graphene layer derived from 2H graphite bulk

source.name: Crystallography Open Database (COD)
source.citation: Trucano, P.; Chen, R. Structure of graphite by neutron diffraction Note: natural crystals. Nature, 258, 136-137 (1975)

normalization.method: pymatgen 2026.5.4 CifParser; full-cell expansion; explicit source-preserving normalization
details: Derived from COD 2H graphite neutron-diffraction bulk record; not an experimental isolated monolayer.
Parsed with pymatgen 2026.5.4 CifParser from the original COD CIF.
Expanded source CIF symmetry to the full stated unit cell with primitive=False; the source cell is preserved for 3D structures.
Checked formula and every atom site; mixed species or explicit fractional/unknown occupancy are rejected rather than ordered.
Mapped each expanded atom to its original CIF atom-site label and 1-based source row; normalized atom IDs are generated from the entry ID and row order.
Derived one layer from COD bulk record 9011577; the complete original 3D-periodic CIF remains source.cif.
Layer selection used plane coordinates in the source fractional c direction and retained 2 formula unit(s) in the selected layer; no H, guest, or atom type was added.
Retained the source a and b vectors; constructed a perpendicular c vector with a 20.0 Å empty gap between repeated layer images; centered the layer along c.
Set PBC to [true, true, false] under the user-approved v0.39 TTF monolayer model. This is a derived monolayer model, not an experimentally isolated monolayer.

entries.name: heptazine-based g-C3N4单层
entries.phase: heptazine-based C6N8 network; monolayer derived from a published periodic g-h-C3N4 model

source.name: NOMAD Repository
source.citation: Botari, T.; Huhn, W. P.; Lau, V. W.-h.; Lotsch, B. V.; Blum, V. Thermodynamic Equilibria in Carbon Nitride Photocatalyst Materials and Conditions for the Existence of Graphitic Carbon Nitride g-C3N4. Chemistry of Materials, 29(10), 4445-4453 (2017), DOI: 10.1021/acs.chemmater.7b00965; NOMAD dataset DOI: 10.17172/NOMAD/2017.04.20-1.

normalization.method: pymatgen 2026.5.4 CifParser; full-cell expansion; explicit source-preserving normalization
details: Source is the published NOMAD g-h-C3N4_SSP_Tyborski model (14-atom C6N8 cell) from Botari et al.; the full periodic source is retained. This one-layer derivative is not an experimentally isolated monolayer.
Parsed with pymatgen 2026.5.4 CifParser from source.cif.
Expanded source crystallographic symmetry to the full stated unit cell with primitive=False; the source cell is preserved for 3D structures.
Checked formula and every atom site; mixed species or explicit fractional/unknown occupancy are rejected rather than ordered.

Converted the retained FHI-aims geometry.in to a P1 source.cif preserving lattice metric, fractional geometry, and atom order; pymatgen may express the same crystal in a rotated Cartesian basis. Source labels are element-index labels because geometry.in has no site labels.

Derived one layer from NOMAD Repository record ibE9rFgMJfrRhwWYQDmtbjBXieZI; The raw NOMAD geometry.in is retained at two-dimensional/gc3n4-heptazine-monolayer/source.geometry.in; source.cif is a P1 format conversion preserving the lattice metric, fractional geometry, and atom order; the raw file preserves the original Cartesian basis.
Layer selection used source-cell coordinates in the source cell and retained 2 formula unit(s) in the selected layer; no H, guest, or atom type was added.
Retained the source a and b vectors; constructed a perpendicular c vector with a 20.0 Å empty gap between repeated layer images; centered the layer along c.
Set PBC to [true, true, false] under the user-approved v0.39 TTF monolayer model. This is a derived monolayer model, not an experimentally isolated monolayer.
The single corrugated sheet crosses the source c-cell boundary; fractional c coordinates were unwrapped across the largest empty periodic interval without changing any atom or in-plane coordinate.
